bindings.reason: Serializes the actual data under data, plus metadata.savedAt from a separate ISO clock read, unsanitized category and operation, the live save-time GA4 propertyId, and original extraInfo only when truthy. The property ID is not evidence of the upstream request's target.
Writes that wrapper as UTF-8 JSON with two-space indentation, replacing the addressed content; undefined object members are omitted by serialization.
entry.loadResult.filepath supplies the actual path for existence check and, if present, the UTF-8 read at ir_455.
Returns the complete parsed JSON value from that read; the assertion supplies no wrapper validation or field filtering.
Missing path or a caught read or parse failure returns null; the caught value is discarded.
entry.listResults.category addresses the directory under live resultsDir; the optional limit is a separate slot.
Filters names ending in .json, joins their paths, then orders descending with localeCompare after splitting each path on '/'. The missing-directory case returns []; no contents are read.
A limit other than undefined is used as slice(0,limit) after ordering; omitted limit returns all ordered paths.

gaps.reason: Ordering uses path/name collation, not timestamps parsed from files, savedAt or modification time. It approximates newest first for ordinary timestamped names but does not establish chronological order in general or resolve ties. A suffix match is not a file type check; the limit is not validated.

A truthy entry.getLatestResult.operation supplies the sanitized substring test on full paths; a falsy value leaves the list unfiltered.
Only the first remaining path reaches loadResult. No candidates returns null at ir_485; a failed load returns null without trying later paths.
Returns that selected read's parsed value or null, with no reassignment to an analysis invocation.

gaps.reason: A substring can match a longer operation, an extra segment or a directory component. The helper does not check exact operation identity in metadata, and inherits the listing order and its limits. It cannot in general establish the most recent result of the requested operation.

gaps.reason: No receiver for summary data, table or trend transformation, recommendation generation, or Markdown write under results/summaries/ is implemented. The workflow obligation survives the tips section; it is not a separate request condition or a requirement on each standalone utility. A parsed value could be observed if actually returned for agent processing, but whole-file acquisition does not show that every field is needed, that a model received it, or that a user received a summary.
